change: Add a Mirror or not mode to the transpose workshop

mutations.name: Aᵀ = −A is tested without the diagonal
the first slip skips the last row
a wrong mirror is never found
the quoted mirror entry is the same entry
the zero-diagonal hint is given for any slip
the cells are drawn with rows and columns swapped
mutations.find: data-rc="${r},${c}" x="${cx+cs/2}" y="${cy+cs/2+5}" fill="${FIG_COL.ink}" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">${neg(A[r][c])}
mutations.replace: data-rc="${r},${c}" x="${cx+cs/2}" y="${cy+cs/2+5}" fill="${FIG_COL.ink}" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">${neg(A[c][r])}

mutations.name: the mirror line runs the other way
calling neither edges the cells red
a fix counts as a first check
the neither button calls Aᵀ = A
the mirror tab opens the pick mode
the pair edged red is only one cell
